items.meaning: Existing clients can book online; new clients book by phone.
items.row: online booking for existing clients only, new clients call us (we need to check the animal first)

items.meaning: Default durations: visit 20 minutes, vaccination 10, surgery as set by the doctor; 30 minutes for birds and reptiles.
items.row: a visit takes 20 minutes, a vaccination 10, 30 for birds and reptiles, surgery is whatever the doctor sets

items.meaning: Two doctors and two rooms; the shared X-ray room is booked together with the visit when needed.
items.row: two doctors, two rooms, the X-ray room is shared and must be booked with the visit when needed

items.meaning: A doctor can block time (Thursday mornings for surgery) that no booking, online included, can take.
items.row: Dr. Iliescu: I need to block my Thursday mornings for surgery and nobody should be able to book a consultation into that block, including online bookings

items.meaning: SMS reminder two days before the appointment.
items.row: reminders: SMS two days before the appointment, not one

items.meaning: The client file shows the animals, last visit, vaccines due and the balance owed.
items.row: the client file shows the animals, last visit, vaccines due, and the balance owed

items.meaning: Late cancellations (under 24 hours) are visible per client with a count.
items.row: we must be able to see who cancelled late (less than 24h) and how many times

items.meaning: An emergency can be overbooked on top of a full day.
items.row: ok to lose: the paper agenda. Not ok to lose: the ability to overbook an emergency on top of a full day

items.meaning: Daily revenue by doctor is visible on the owner's phone in the morning.
items.row: Mihnea (owner): I want the daily revenue by doctor on my phone in the morning

items.meaning: The vaccination certificate prints from the visit with the stamp image, in Romanian and English.
items.row: printing the vaccination certificate from the visit, with the stamp image, in both languages, Romanian and English (the EU pet passport people ask for it)

items.meaning: The boarding kennel (6 places) has its own calendar but the same client file.
items.row: the boarding kennel (6 places) is a different calendar but the same client file

items.meaning: Reminders stop the same day an animal is marked deceased.
items.row: Ana: when a pet is marked deceased the reminders must stop the same day, we had a complaint last month

items.meaning: No app; the website is enough.
items.row: No app, the website is enough.

items.meaning: Clients can request their file and the clinic exports it (GDPR).
items.row: GDPR: clients can ask for their file and we export it

must_not_invent: a reminder one day before (superseded in the thread)
notes: The thread revises itself: one day before becomes two days before, 20 minutes becomes 30 for birds and reptiles. The expected items carry the final value. G02-08 is listed under Client file, where it sits in the source; the runner reports placement and does not fail on it. "Keep it cheap" is not a row.
